title: Lecture 8 — building blocks and timing
summary: Build combinational functions from multiplexers and decoders, then reason about delay bounds and transient glitches.
body:
This guide uses the retained lecture deck. The current Canvas lecture listing and weekly planner were checked on 21 September and confirm this lecture's scheduled date and topic; the full PDF has not been redownloaded and actual classroom coverage is not a transcript. No attendance or completion is inferred.

First treat the mux as a controlled choice and the decoder as an address-to-minterm mapping. Then move beyond the truth table: outputs need time to settle, and different internal paths may temporarily disagree. The examples and self-checks below are original practice, not submitted course work.
